newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-D.Jones sees yr profit mid-A$30s mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-D.Jones sees yr profit mid-A$30s mln.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its net profit in the 1996/97 financial year to be around the mid-30 million dollar mark.

Asked whether he expected David Jones' profit to be within the range of analysts' forecast, which is between A$32 and A$37 million, finance director Robert Wright said: "We expect to be in the mid-thirties. We expect to be somewhere in that range".
David Jones earlier reported a net profit after tax of A$22.34 million in the six months ended Januray 25, 1997, compared with a net profit of A$44.64 million a year earlier.
Chairman Richard Warburton said the half year results were helped by a good January, but described the half year result as "disappointing."
"February saw a bit of a correction from the January upturn, but we have seen a slight increase in March," Warburton said.
David Jones reported a net profit of A$67.53 million in the 1995/96 year.
Warburton said discretionary spending on David Jones products, which are about 50 percent of the group's products, had been very tough.
At 1.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), David Jones shares were three cents down at A$1.71.
